name: 材料カードの含有食品の案内を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE compact Japanese Lighthouse ingredient information card LH19-0004 on pure white canvas, portrait card close framing with modest margins.
INPUT HIERARCHY: image1 ORIGINAL sweetgreen screenshot controls fine-detail anatomy, proportions, alignment and spacing. Relevant card ONLY is Caesar at right of Dressings section, including red Contains fish warning. Do not add surrounding salad controls, other cards, navigation or buttons. Image2 original Caesar dressing photo crop is protected artwork: preserve this exact white bowl, creamy speckled sauce, shadow, beige image backdrop, crop and colors. Image3 Japanese mock is secondary content/layout guide; source controls any disputed details. Image4 is approved Lighthouse style only: white rounded surfaces, fine neutral border, soft downward elevation.
Card contains exactly top label 「シーザー」, centered original food photograph, bottom warning 「魚を含みます」. Preserve source visible neutral unselected state. Warning red #B63F32 expresses actual contains-fish information; preserve this purposeful semantic accent and explicit text, no extra allergen claims, no green status or safe checkmark. No additional CTA/brand badge: this is informational, no primary action.
Typography locked Meiryo, label regular14/24 at logical scale, warning metadata12/16, tracking0. Keep readable full wording, balanced compact whitespace, subtle white rounded card and light neutral outline. Outer canvas pure #FFFFFF; white card; beige restricted to original photograph. No broad mint, random icon, inflated headings, extra ingredients, allergy-free claim, invented controls, watermark.
reviewNotes: 原本の赤い魚含有表示を意味ある警告として保持。シーザー／魚を含みます、白カードと対象外操作の除外を確認。ラベルが指定Regularより太く、写真の器と質感が原本から再描画され厳密保持は未達。修正予定。所有者承認・編集可能性・実提供食品情報・アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
